contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: The strongest measured convergence is selective rather than market-wide: technology demand/IP signals, policy-linked activity, and event-driven catalysts align in a few non-extended names. With no completed track-record observations, these reads warrant modest conviction despite unusually broad channel counts.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: MU's alignment spans insider activity, a dense patent cluster, accelerating government-grant activity, and uniformly bullish retail sentiment [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [gov_grant] [stocktwits_bull]. These channels point toward semiconductor investment and institutional-policy support from different directions, while the stock is non-extended; retail unanimity, however, raises crowding risk.
second_order: Semiconductor equipment — MU's patent and grant activity implies continued memory-manufacturing investment.
Data-center memory supply chain — stronger memory investment can support advanced packaging, testing, and substrate demand.
Domestic semiconductor infrastructure — grant acceleration can benefit U.S. fab construction and specialty-material suppliers.

falsifier.text: Insider support disappears and grant or patent activity fails to translate into sustained manufacturing or end-demand evidence.

signals.thesis: MSFT shows coherent product-and-innovation breadth through app demand, GitHub momentum, patent clustering, and its established partnership with Sam Altman [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman]. This is a more operationally connected mix than pure sentiment, but the 60-day relative gain reduces entry asymmetry even though it remains below the pack's extended threshold.
second_order: AI data-center infrastructure — product and developer momentum imply sustained compute, networking, cooling, and power requirements.
Enterprise software ecosystem — GitHub activity can support developer tooling, cybersecurity, and integration partners.
Advanced semiconductors — continued AI-platform demand can benefit accelerators, memory, and high-speed connectivity suppliers.

falsifier.text: App and GitHub momentum weaken together without corresponding evidence of enterprise adoption or AI monetization.

signals.thesis: MRK combines late-stage clinical starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, lobbying, and a special situation [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [special_situation]. The channels form a plausible regulatory-and-pipeline catalyst stack, but four clinical halts and substantial recent relative strength make the payoff distribution less attractive and argue for watching rather than adding now.
second_order: Clinical research services — numerous Phase 3 starts can increase trial-management and patient-recruitment demand.
Drug manufacturing and packaging — successful label expansion can require additional commercial supply capacity.
Healthcare diagnostics — broader treatment eligibility can increase companion-testing and screening activity.

falsifier.text: Clinical halts broaden or the anticipated label expansion fails to produce a durable commercial opportunity.

signals.thesis: AMZN has the pack's broadest convergence, combining lobbying, clustered analyst upgrades, hedge-fund-model momentum, a special situation, and disclosed political ownership by Nancy Pelosi [lobbying] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [hf_model_momentum] [special_situation] [actor:Nancy Pelosi]. Its 60-day relative underperformance and non-extended status leave room for the signals to be expressed without chasing, although several inputs are sentiment or affiliation rather than operating evidence.
second_order: Cloud and data-center infrastructure — hedge-fund-model momentum around AMZN can imply continued hyperscale workload demand.
Digital advertising — improving platform attention and analyst sentiment can support the broader commerce-ad ecosystem.
Logistics automation — a stronger commerce platform outlook can benefit warehouse, robotics, and delivery-capacity suppliers.

falsifier.text: Analyst support and model momentum reverse while no operating-demand channel emerges over the next two reporting cycles.

signals.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

broken_signals.thesis: LUV's activist 13D, disclosed Paul Singer affiliation, app-demand signal, and policy-linked buy indication create an event-driven turnaround setup [activist_13d] [actor:Paul Singer] [app_demand] [trump]. Its relative underperformance and non-extended status improve the prospective entry backdrop, but app ratings and political linkage do not demonstrate profitable demand, so the evidence is not yet strong enough for an accumulate call.
second_order: Aircraft maintenance and parts — an activist-led operating reset could redirect spending toward fleet reliability and utilization.
Travel distribution — improved app engagement can support booking and ancillary-service ecosystems.
U.S. leisure travel — stabilization at LUV would imply firmer domestic passenger demand for airports and travel services.

falsifier.text: Activist involvement produces no measurable operating change and app engagement fails to coincide with improving profitable demand.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
